about: Forty sentences for the intent box, ten per mode, each with the plan it should become (AGENTS.md, Contracts, Experience). scripts/check-intents.ts asks Gemini for a plan from each sentence alone (kind avatar for play, replay otherwise) and reports mismatches; tests/plan.test.ts checks that clean() keeps every right answer right. environment null means leave it out (the user's own room, same as "room"); objects lists the nouns that must be there, alternatives split by |, extras allowed; strength is the chess level for play.

cases.name: Piano piece
cases.sentence: sit next to me and teach me this piece
cases.why: Showcase 1. An instrument lesson, side by side as asked; a piano's home is the concert hall.

cases.name: Jump shot
cases.sentence: teach me this jump shot
cases.why: Showcase 2. Sport form you follow from behind; a shot needs the ball and the hoop it aims at.

cases.name: First strum
cases.sentence: teach me this strum
cases.why: An instrument lesson: beside you, so your strumming hand mirrors theirs from the same side; music's home is the concert hall.

cases.name: Violin
cases.sentence: help me learn this violin passage
cases.why: An instrument lesson, beside you; the violin is named, so it is an object.

cases.name: Salsa
cases.sentence: teach me this salsa step
cases.why: A dance you follow like a class; dance's home is the studio; nothing to hold.

cases.name: Squats
cases.sentence: coach me through this squat so my form looks like his
cases.why: Workout form you copy from behind; a workout's home is the gym.

cases.name: Serve
cases.sentence: break down her tennis serve for me
cases.why: Sport form, ahead; the court place is a basketball court, so tennis has no home in the list.

cases.name: Omelette
cases.sentence: teach me how she flips the omelette
cases.why: Cooking: you watch their hands across the counter, facing you; no kitchen place, so no environment.

cases.name: Paper crane
cases.sentence: show me how to fold this origami crane
cases.why: A craft done with the hands at a table: facing; no home.

cases.name: Boxing combo
cases.sentence: teach me this boxing combo
cases.why: A whole-body move you shadow from behind; boxing's home is the ring.

cases.name: Grandma
cases.sentence: I just want to sit with her
cases.why: Showcase 4. Company, not a performance: facing you, in your own room.

cases.name: Mom
cases.sentence: just be with me
cases.why: The intent box's own suggestion for a companion.

cases.name: Dad
cases.sentence: keep me company while I cook dinner
cases.why: What the user does meanwhile (cooking) doesn't make it a lesson.

cases.name: Grandpa
cases.sentence: I miss my grandpa, I want him here for a while
cases.why: Someone you've lost, simply there.

cases.name: Nana
cases.sentence: I want to hear her voice again
cases.why: Her own recorded voice and captions come with a companion; nothing is said as her.

cases.name: Mom
cases.sentence: have my mom here for my birthday
cases.why: Presence for a moment in your life, at home.

cases.name: Grandpa
cases.sentence: sit next to me on the couch like old times
cases.why: Companions face you so you can see them; 'next to me' means beside only in a lesson, where you copy them.

cases.name: My brother
cases.sentence: take me to the mountains with my brother
cases.why: A companion stays in your room unless the user names a place, and here they do.

cases.name: Grandma
cases.sentence: have coffee with me in the morning like we used to
cases.why: A shared routine is company, not a lesson.

cases.name: Dad
cases.sentence: stay with me tonight, I don't want to be alone
cases.why: Comfort: simply there, facing you.

cases.name: My jump shot
cases.sentence: show me doing it
cases.why: Showcase 5 (you, perfected): seeing yourself do the shot, not a lesson; the court is its home.

cases.name: Ballet solo
cases.sentence: let me watch her dance this ballet solo
cases.why: A performance you watch from the front; dance's home is the studio.

cases.name: Cello
cases.sentence: play this cello piece for me
cases.why: 'Play' means playing the music back, never a game; an audience faces the player.

cases.name: Morning workout
cases.sentence: I want to follow along with this workout
cases.why: Following along at full speed is watch, with them ahead of you like an instructor.

cases.name: Shadowboxing
cases.sentence: let me watch his shadowboxing up close
cases.why: Watching, so facing; boxing's home is the ring.

cases.name: Piano
cases.sentence: I just want to hear him play the piano
cases.why: A performance, not a game and not a lesson; the piano is named.

cases.name: Tai chi
cases.sentence: let me watch his tai chi in the mountains
cases.why: The user names the place, so it wins.

cases.name: Kickflip
cases.sentence: show me this skateboard trick again
cases.why: Seeing it again, not learning it; skateboarding has no home in the list.

cases.name: Dance
cases.sentence: put her dance on so I can dance along
cases.why: Dancing along at full speed: watch, ahead of you; dance's home is the studio.

cases.name: Wedding toast
cases.sentence: play back grandpa's toast from the wedding
cases.why: Plain playback of a home video; nothing has a home, so no environment.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: play chess with me
cases.why: Showcase 3 and the intent box's suggestion: across a board at your table; no level named, so club.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: play chess with me at Magnus Carlsen's level
cases.why: The legend is only a strength: Stockfish at Carlsen's peak rating, never his likeness.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: I want a game at Bobby Fischer's peak rating
cases.why: 'A game' means chess, the only game there is.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: let's play a game across the table, go easy on me
cases.why: No chess word at all; going easy is the club level.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: give me a grandmaster-level chess game
cases.why: A grandmaster is the gm level.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: play chess against me at full strength
cases.why: Full strength is max.

cases.name: Dad
cases.sentence: I want to play chess with my dad again
cases.why: A family member at the board is still play, not a companion; no level named.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: a quick chess match, expert level
cases.why: The level is named.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: teach me chess by playing a game with me
cases.why: Chess is always play, even phrased as a lesson: there is no move to slow down.

cases.name: Chess partner
cases.sentence: challenge me like a chess master would
cases.why: A master is the master level, below a grandmaster.
